# croaring / croaring_fuzzer_cc

croaring's own fuzz target `croaring_fuzzer_cc` ([source](source/croaring_fuzzer_cc.cc), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over CRoaring 5.1.0 (RoaringBitmap/CRoaring at 0489dd47).

Checks 2 properties (listed below); the first, an API contract: Roaring::write() must write exactly getSizeInBytes() bytes.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against CRoaring 5.1.0 at commit 0489dd47 with 1 patch to the library (listed on the project page).
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
- Roaring::write() must write exactly getSizeInBytes() bytes ([lines 151-153](source/croaring_fuzzer_cc.cc#L151-L153)): assert(); confirmed in the binary.
- serialize (write) then readSafe must reproduce a bitmap equal to b (after ~25 set operations on fuzzed data) ([lines 154-156](source/croaring_fuzzer_cc.cc#L154-L156)): assert(); confirmed in the binary.

A failed check marked as ending the process contradicts every halts statement below, so a proof of one implies them on every input it covers.
